Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Manoj Patil. I am a 59-year-old architect living in Ahmedabad. Simran Menon has filed a police complaint against me over 25.4 lakh rupees, and the complaint was filed during a matrimonial dispute. My case number is Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1380/2019 in the Ahmedabad Sessions Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 81656 09240 or email manoj.patil@example.in.
